verdict.rationale: Ultrametric is built to be driven through natural language, but only via the user's own agent host. The product 'runs no model' (docs-4); instead the user's agent handles processes like incorporation and payroll (docs-1, docs-34) and is asked to call MCP tools (docs-26). It connects through a remote MCP server (docs-5, docs-27) or through skill files for Codex and Claude Code, whose installation is hands-on verified (docs-30, selfeval-2), and agent-oriented --json CLI output (docs-22). Natural-language operation therefore depends on an external agent, and no end-to-end natural-language session has been observed: hosted MCP and process calls stop at the auth wall (selfeval-4, selfeval-5, audit-20261014-2). Missing for 10: a native natural-language interface that needs no third-party agent, hands-on evidence of a natural-language-driven run through a hosted process, independent corroboration.
